baseline_failures: Gripping either controller does not lock a menu neutral handshake
Back is available during neutral gating but never during a blurred session
Either controller stick navigates menus; riding remains left-stick only
Actual menu poll accepts A while HTML is hidden but XR is visible
Actual menu poll navigates without desktop focus
Actual menu poll lets B escape a pending neutral state
Holding Back retains one button identity across a menu close
Right-stick menu input does not depend on source ordering
baseline_success: Actual menu poll blocks input while XR is hidden or blurred
method: Execute the original controller mapping and extracted actual Flight Deck poll with controlled DOM/XR visibility, buttons and sticks. Then run the complete repaired local rule suite. No fabricated hardware or browser-renderer acceptance is inferred.
limitations: This reproduces code-level conditions, not the user's exact physical Quest session. The exact physical origin of the reported plane is not proven from its text description. Hosted stereo/head-motion and pixel-mask tests are separate gates.
